name: Objector.ai
tagline: AI-powered planning objection letter and toolkit to help citizens challenge unsuitable planning applications
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: Reliance on UK planning policy which may change
Dependency on AI model accuracy for policy interpretation
documented_limitations: Requires users to upload planning documents manually
Effectiveness depends on quality of AI policy interpretation
failure_modes: AI may misidentify valid objection grounds
Policy references may become outdated with planning law changes
Local council variations may not be fully captured
ai_involvement: Dual AI-powered system for identifying objection grounds, generating letters, and providing policy explanations

scraped.scraped_description:
Object to planning applications in the UK with Objector.ai. Check objection 
grounds for free & create powerful, policy-based objection letters, 
lobbying videos, and committee speeches in minutes.
